description: This file defines types, structures, macros, and function prototypes for handling radio event handlers in a wireless LAN context. It includes typedefs for callback functions, handler structures, and macros for initialization.

methods.name: wld_radEvtHandler_handleEventByName
methods.description: Handles a radio event by name, dispatching to the appropriate handler based on interface name.

methods.name: wld_radEvtHandler_handleEventByIndex
methods.description: Handles a radio event by index, dispatching to the appropriate handler based on interface index.
